_comment: Valid STDF filename conventions used by 'Get STDF' when extracting STDF files from the server.
A server file is fetched ONLY if its name matches one of the conventions configured for the
lot's MASK (first 5 characters of the MPC) and the selected TESTER platform. Everything else is ignored.
{lot}       = the Lot ID exactly as entered (e.g. MMT-272500536.800)
{N}         = retest number, one or more digits (e.g. rj1, rj2, rj12)
A convention may appear anywhere in the filename (at the start, or in the middle preceded by a device prefix
like 'ATA5293_'). Anything after the convention must begin with '_' or '.' (e.g. '_ft1.stdf.old' or '.std.bak'),
and the file must have a valid STDF extension.
To add a new FTDC device: add its 5-character mask under 'masks', and either reference a
shared platform template by name (e.g. "V93K": "V93K") or write its own conventions
object. Each category value may be a single string or a list of strings.
Restart the app after editing this file.
